name: ITR-1 (Sahaj)
applicableFor: Resident individuals with income up to ₹50 Lakhs from salary, one house property, and other sources (like interest).
notFor: Not for NRIs, capital gains, business income, or foreign assets.

name: ITR-2
applicableFor: Individuals and HUFs with income over ₹50 Lakhs, capital gains, foreign assets, or multiple house properties.
notFor: Not for those with business or professional income.

name: ITR-3
applicableFor: Individuals and HUFs with income from a proprietary business or profession.
notFor: Not for those opting for presumptive taxation (44AD/44ADA).

name: ITR-4 (Sugam)
applicableFor: Individuals, HUFs, and firms with presumptive business income (Section 44AD, 44ADA, 44AE) and total income up to ₹50 Lakhs.
notFor: Not for capital gains, foreign assets, or regular business income.
